name: render-source-equations
command:
import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
import subprocess,base64,json,sys
from pathlib import Path
p=Path.cwd();images=[]
for src,page,name in [('inputs/lr.pdf',13,'target13'),('inputs/lr.pdf',14,'target14'),('sources/rassart.pdf',6,'rassart6'),('sources/quiver.pdf',14,'quiver14')]:
 r=subprocess.run(['pdftoppm','-f',str(page),'-l',str(page),'-singlefile','-scale-to','1400','-png',src],capture_output=True);assert r.returncode==0
 b=base64.b64encode(r.stdout).decode();w=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(p/'write_lane.py'),'figures/'+name+'.png','--base64'],input=b,text=True,capture_output=True);assert w.returncode==0
 images.append(b)
print(json.dumps(images))
